Go/No-Go Task

The word GO or STOP will appear in the center of the screen.

Press the space bar as quickly as possible when you see GO.
Do not press anything when you see STOP.

Use the index finger of your dominant hand.

Respond as quickly and as accurately as possible.

An arrow will appear in the center of the screen.

Press the Left Arrow key if it points left.
Press the Right Arrow key if it points right.

Use the index and middle fingers of your right hand, one on each key.

On some trials a red circle will appear above the arrow shortly after it. When you see the red circle, try not to press anything.

Respond as quickly as possible. Do not wait for the red circle.
